title: Results and receipts are terminal evidence, not decision authority
summary: AlchemyAutobuildEvidence records an already-made orchestration outcome. It persists result JSON, per-test stdout/stderr and a terminal receipt together through accepted-main transaction; the receipt is the idempotency surface for subsequent scans.
invariants: Evidence does not execute packages and does not decide PASS/FAIL.
A receipt path is autobuild/receipts/<submission-id>.json and is terminal/idempotent.
Result evidence records package, source, publication, per-test status/return code/timeout/cwd, bounded environment and log paths.
An existing receipt is preserved; it is not replaced by a later run using the same submission id.

provenance.claim: Result/log/receipt persistence in one accepted-main transaction.
